title: Mach–Zehnder modulator
description: Nonlinear power transfer T=cos²(πV/(2Vpi)+bias/2) × 10^(−loss/10). Uses MachZehnderModulator.transfer. Envelope phase is passed through; modulator chirp and coherent field sign are not modeled.

params.name: bias_rad
params.description: Differential bias phase; transfer uses bias_rad / 2.

params.name: loss_dB
params.description: Deterministic insertion loss; remains active with noise off.
